S  directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  IA No.01 of 2022 (Compounding Application)
 With  C482 No.1319 of 2022  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani, Advocate, for the applicants.
Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, AGA, for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Mohit Kumar, Advocate, for the respondent.

The parties inter se in the present C482 application had been in rift in various criminal proceedings,
being Criminal Case No.2887 of 2015, "State Vs. Kirti Singh and others", Criminal Case No.4617 of 2016, "State Vs. Kunwarjeet and others" which has already been compounded by this Court by the earlier orders passed in the respective C482 applications.

entities.text: State Vs. Kirti Singh and others"
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In fact, in the instant C482 application, where the challenge has been given by the applicants, to the proceedings of the Criminal Case No.383 of 2022, "State Vs. Pradeep Singh and others", which was in relation to the offences which were punishable under sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 120B and 34 of IPC, which emanated as a consequence of the registration of the FIR No.279 of 2015, as it was registered by the complainant/respondent no.2, on 26.10.2015, against the named accused person,
therein, for their involvement in commission of the offences as detailed above.

entities.text: State Vs. Pradeep Singh and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having gone through the contents of the FIR, it seems that the entire controversy as narrated in the FIR, in fact it is reflected that it was as a consequence of the simultaneous criminal proceedings which has been drawn by the applicants, herein, and the registration of the present FIR was nothing but a revengeful aptitude by way of counter blast, and particularly, it entails consideration of the private dispute, which has been mentioned in the FIR.

Upon the culmination of the investigation, the Chargesheet No.267 of 2021, was submitted by the Investigating Officer on 11.07.2021, on which the Investigating Officer having prima facie found that The Parties Inter Se In The Present C482 vs Unknown on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31240078/

the offences as detailed above, are made out against the present applicants, on which the cognizance has been taken by the court of Judicial Magistrate, Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar, thereby registering the Criminal Case No.383 of 2022, "State Vs. Pradeep Singh and others".

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate, Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: State Vs. Pradeep Singh and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: These offences are being sought to be compounded almost on the identical ground, as it has been referred to in the earlier compounding application, as dealt with in C482 No.1313 of 2022 and C482 No.1321 of 2022.

Owing to the fact that it was a matrimonial feud between the parties, which has now been resolved because the decree has already been rendered under section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, the parties do not intend to proceed any further, in the matter which is the subject matter of consideration before the court of Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

In order to summarize the issue, since the parties have settled their dispute, despite of the fact that some of the offences are not compoundable, but looking to the entire conspicuous of the case, as the dispute is private in nature, and it directly had nexus with regards to the other criminal proceedings,
keeping these proceedings, pending consideration, which exclusively entails a civil litigation will not be a fruitful exercise because it will be unnecessarily engaging the parties to the C482 application in a fruitless criminal proceedings, which otherwise is not being sought to be persuaded by the complainant/respondent no.2, who is present in the proceedings, and has participated through video conferencing and made a statement that he doesn't intends to prosecute the present applicants owing to decree under section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act any further in terms of the compounding application, which has been duly signed by all the parties, including their counsels verifying the contents of the same.

Owing to the fact that, the parties have now entered into an amicable settlement, this C482 application would stand closed and as a consequence, thereto, the proceedings of the Criminal Case No.383 of 2022, "State Vs. Pradeep Singh and others", pending consideration before the court of Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar, would hereby stand quashed.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 18.08.2023 NR The Parties Inter Se In The Present C482 vs Unknown on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31240078/
